about: Stills for the Quiet direction of the home page (.impeccable/mocks/fresh/quiet). One photograph per chapter, all in one soft daylight grade. Founder approved all image creation for this work in chat on 2026-11-01.

defaults.suffix: Photoreal, documentary, natural light, soft contrast, true colour, fine film grain. One continuous shot, slow and physical camera move, no cuts. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, neon, lens flare, bokeh circles, light orbs, purple, glowing orbs or rockets. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera.
defaults.stillSuffix: Wide horizontal 16:9 photograph. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm or 50mm lens, natural light, true colour with a gentle warm film grade, each room real and specific with its own wall colour and objects, true skin texture with pores and fine detail, natural hands with five fingers, subtle fine film grain, editorial documentary photograph, not staged. No text, letters, numbers, logos, crests, brand marks or watermarks anywhere, including on clothing, walls, books and devices. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera. No paper, notebooks, pens, pencils or calculators. No purple, neon, lens flare or bokeh circles.

stills.prompt: A 17-year-old girl studying alone at a plain light-oak desk beside a tall window in late afternoon. Her laptop is open on the desk, seen from the side so its screen faces away from the camera. White wireless earbuds, hair loosely tied back, one hand resting near her chin, eyes on the laptop, fully focused, calm. She sits in the right third of the frame; the left two thirds is a plain warm off-white plaster wall softly lit by the window. A single ceramic mug. Quiet, spare room.
